title: Zig: Variables
description: Declare variables of different types in Zig and print them.

steps.title: Declare and Print Variables
steps.description: Declare const age: u8 = 25, var price: f64 = 9.99, const grade: u8 = 'A'. Print each using std.debug.print with the proper format specifier.
hints: For chars: `'{c}'` or print the ASCII value.
